1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 3 m de longitud, con cabeza grande y aletas radiadas, su coloración oscila entre el pardo, el naranja y el rosado, con manchas y rayas de diferentes colores; es comestible. Serranidae; Epinephelus spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 3 meters in length, with a large head and radiated fins, its coloration ranges from brown, orange, and pink, with spots and stripes of various colors; it is edible. Serranidae; Epinephelus spp.
